subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/ContextEngine control API after the code-level blockers are fixed?
rationale: The session-key and error-handling bugs are mechanical, but the permanent Gateway route names, operator scopes, optional ContextEngine hooks, and admin rotate capability are new public API direction that automation cannot accept on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Approve after blockers are fixed
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, sanitized failure handling, focused regression tests, and a refreshed clean branch before merge.

options.title: Narrow the API first
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer core control API
options.body: Pause or close the PR if context-engine maintenance control should remain plugin-private until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, sanitized failure handling, focused regression tests, and a refreshed clean branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway operator/session ownership and current session canonicalization behavior where vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history.
